description: This file defines classes and functions related to an interactive launcher for Kivy applications, including thread-safe proxies (SafeMembrane) and a launcher class (InteractiveLauncher) that runs an App in a separate thread, facilitating interactive development and debugging.

classes.name: SafeMembrane
classes.description: A thread-safe proxy object that wraps around another object, providing synchronized access and method calls, used to safely interact with Kivy's EventLoop and objects across threads.

classes.name: InteractiveLauncher
classes.description: A proxy class that runs a Kivy App in a separate thread, allowing interactive development, debugging, and dynamic attribute addition with thread safety.

methods.name: safeWait
methods.description: Schedules a wait on the EventLoop's confirmation and safe events, used for thread synchronization.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Recursively retrieves the underlying object from a SafeMembrane proxy.

methods.name: SafeMembrane.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the proxy with the referenced object and links to EventLoop's threading events.

methods.name: SafeMembrane.safeIn
methods.description: Enters a thread-safe context, pausing the EventLoop for safe interaction.

methods.name: SafeMembrane.safeOut
methods.description: Exits the thread-safe context, allowing the EventLoop to continue.

methods.name: SafeMembrane.isMethod
methods.description: Checks if a given function is a method.

methods.name: SafeMembrane.__repr__
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the underlying object.

methods.name: SafeMembrane.__call__
methods.description: Calls the underlying object if callable, with thread safety.

methods.name: SafeMembrane.__getattribute__
methods.description: Gets an attribute from the underlying object, with special handling for internal attributes.

methods.name: SafeMembrane.__getattr__
methods.description: Gets an attribute from the underlying object, returning a SafeMembrane proxy.

methods.name: SafeMembrane.__setattr__
methods.description: Sets an attribute on the underlying object with thread safety.

methods.name: SafeMembrane.__delattr__
methods.description: Deletes an attribute from the underlying object with thread safety.

methods.name: SafeMembrane.__bool__
methods.description: Returns the boolean value of the underlying object.

methods.name: SafeMembrane.__getitem__
methods.description: Gets an item from the underlying object, wrapped in a SafeMembrane.

methods.name: SafeMembrane.__setitem__
methods.description: Sets an item on the underlying object with thread safety.

methods.name: SafeMembrane.__delitem__
methods.description: Deletes an item from the underlying object with thread safety.

methods.name: SafeMembrane.__getslice__
methods.description: Gets a slice from the underlying object, wrapped in a SafeMembrane.

methods.name: SafeMembrane.__setslice__
methods.description: Sets a slice on the underlying object with thread safety.

methods.name: SafeMembrane.__delslice__
methods.description: Deletes a slice from the underlying object with thread safety.

methods.name: SafeMembrane.__enter__
methods.description: Enters a context, calling __enter__ on the underlying object.

methods.name: SafeMembrane.__exit__
methods.description: Exits a context, calling __exit__ on the underlying object.

methods.name: InteractiveLauncher.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the launcher, setting up threading, event loop, and starting the app in a separate thread.

methods.name: InteractiveLauncher.run
methods.description: Starts the app thread and sets the proxy reference.

methods.name: InteractiveLauncher.stop
methods.description: Signals the app to quit and joins the thread.

methods.name: InteractiveLauncher.__repr__
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the app.
